## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): subject`)
- [ ] Linked to an issue (`Closes #` above)
- [ ] One logical change, scoped and reviewable
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing, or a waiver is documented here, in the commit, and in the issue
- [ ] Docs updated in this PR, including USAGE.md if the download's behaviour changed
- [ ] Correct labels set (`kind/*`, `status/*`, and any flags)
- [ ] No secrets, and no AI attribution in commits or this description
